items.title: Authorities searching for 4 adults and 2 kids on plane that crashed near Mississippi’s Horn Island
items.brief: Authorities are searching for six people after a plane crashed into the water northeast of Horn Island, Mississippi , on Tuesday afternoon, the US Coast Guard said.

items.title: Trump says pardon for Jensen Huang is ‘always an option’ but likely won’t be needed
items.brief: President Donald Trump said Tuesday he would be open to pardoning newly reinstated Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for any potential crimes — but he added that it likely won’t be needed.

items.title: Like ‘family businesses’: Inside the Nvidia board that ousted and rehired Jensen Huang
items.brief: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang gushed last year that support from longtime board members Tench Coxe, Mark Stevens and Harvey Jones was crucial to helping him navigate three decades of running the company.

items.title: CIA hit by hack impacting unclassified information
items.brief: The CIA and Office of the Director of National Intelligence suffered an apparent hack affecting unclassified information, four sources familiar with the matter told CNN.
